About Us TechMinds is an HR consultancy with a main focus on Tech &
IT. Your advantage: Through us, your application documents are sent
directly to the decision maker. In addition, you benefit from free
advice on all your career questions. And you get an authentic insight
into the daily work routine of your potential employer at an early
stage. Tasks You develop and improve the distributional forecasting
models of a growing software company in the grocery retail sector,
working across model architecture, calibration and coverage You deepen
existing production models, monitor forecast quality metrics
continuously and act quickly when performance degrades You identify
where current approaches reach their limits and shape what comes next
methodologically You make substantial contributions to the inventory
simulation and ordering policy framework and drive improvements
through to production You shape the technical direction in your focus
area, contribute to methodology decisions and hold a high bar for code
quality, testability and production readiness across the team You take
responsibility for end-to-end pipeline quality, from input data
integrity through forecast output to the performance of live order
recommendations, including regular backtesting and monitoring You ship
production-quality work with well-tested, readable and thoroughly
reviewed code, using agentic AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code,
Cursor) as part of your daily workflow You work closely with
engineering, product, sales and customer operations and translate
operational findings from store level into product improvements
Profile You hold an MSc or PhD in a quantitative field such as
statistics, mathematics, physics, operations research or computer
science You have built systems that make decisions under uncertainty
with real operational consequences, not just research prototypes Your
background is in at least one of probabilistic forecasting, stochastic
inventory simulation or operations research, with solid working
knowledge across the others You are deeply familiar with
distributional and probabilistic forecasting methods (e.g. quantile
regression, LGBM with distributional output, GAMLSS-type models,
conformal prediction) You have a solid grounding in stochastic
inventory theory, newsvendor models, related ordering policies and
service level optimisation You write production-grade Python and SQL
on large, messy, real-world data and have experience with ML model
evaluation and monitoring in production settings You are comfortable
working with GCP (BigQuery, Cloud Run, Vertex AI) and dbt, and you are
familiar with workflow orchestration (Airflow or Cloud Composer), Git,
containerisation and CI/CD You use agentic AI coding tools (Claude
Code, Cursor or similar) with daily fluency You translate complex
mathematical reasoning into decisions that product teams and
non-technical colleagues can act on You ideally bring experience from
supply chain optimisation, demand planning or retail, ideally combined
with startup or scale-up experience You are fluent in English; German
is not required Benefits You receive an attractive compensation
package including equity participation (VSOP) Home-Office
possibilities 30 vacation days You receive individual relocation
support if you are moving to Berlin Kontakt Further details apart from

KINDERPSYCHOLOGE (M/W/D)

CHILD PSYCHOLOGIST / KINDERPSYCHOLOGE (M/W/D) – ENGLISH-SPEAKING POSITION

Kennziffer: Child Psychologist

ABOUT US:

Joy Center Family Institute is a multidisciplinary clinic specializing in child development, emotional well-being, and family support. Located in Böblingen (Stuttgart), we serve a diverse international community, including civilians families connected to the U.S. military.

We are known for our holistic, relationship-based, and play-centered therapy approach, following developmental models like DIR/FLOORTIME. Our mission is to empower children and families while nurturing growth, connection, and emotional well-being.

WE ARE CONTINUOUSLY EXPANDING OUR TEAM AND ARE CURRENTLY HIRING:

• Clinical Child Psychologists.
• Licensed Psychotherapists (able to work in Germany).
• Occupational Therapists.
• Speech and Language Therapists.

CURRENT VACANCY: Clinical Child Psychologist / Psychotherapist.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

• THERAPEUTIC WORK: Provide individual and family-based psychological therapy for children aged 2-15. Focus areas often include developmental challenges, emotional regulation, behavioral concerns, social skills, and attachment-based issues.
• DEVELOPMENTAL FOCUS: Apply relationship-based, play-based models such as DIR/Floortime to foster emotional and developmental growth.
• ASSESSMENTS: Conduct psychological assessments and developmental screenings as needed.
• FAMILY SUPPORT: Engage, coach, and collaborate with parents and caregivers as part of each child's therapeutic journey.
• MULTIDISCIPLINARY TEAM COLLABORATION: Participate in regular weekly supervision and team case discussions with other psychologists, occupational therapists, and speech/language therapists.
• DOCUMENTATION: Maintain accurate, timely clinical notes and assessment reports.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

• Degree in Psychology (Master's or Doctorate level).
• Licensed as a CLINICAL PSYCHOLOGIST or PSYCHOLOGICAL PSYCHOTHERAPIST with eligibility to practice in Germany (e.g., approbation or equivalent).
• Experience working with young children and families, ideally with ages 2 to 15.
• Familiarity with developmental models such as DIR/Floortime, play therapy, or other child-centered approaches (or willingness to learn).
• English fluency (our client base is international).
• Strong interpersonal skills, flexibility, and genuine passion for child development and family-centered work.

WHAT WE OFFER:

• FULL-TIME POSITION: 40 hours per week, with a balance between clinical work (28 hours) and time for documentation, supervision, and team meetings (12 hours).
• ONGOING SUPERVISION: Weekly individual and group supervision sessions plus staff meetings for professional growth and peer support.
• PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT: Opportunities for continued training and workshops.
• MULTIDISCIPLINARY ENVIRONMENT: Work alongside a diverse and supportive team of psychologists, occupational therapists, and speech-language therapists.
• MEANINGFUL WORK: Directly impact the lives of children and families in a nurturing, play-based setting.

LEARN MORE:

www.joycenterfamily.com [https://www.joycenterfamily.com/]

Join our mission to help every child reach their full potential through developmentally respectful, relationship-based care. Apply now [https://apply.jcd.de/Apply.php?iJobAdID=107895&tc=3-11]

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
- 8 years of technology related sales, business development, channel sales, or partner management experience.
- Ability to communicate in German and English fluently to support client relationship management in this region

Preferred qualifications:

- Experience building business partnerships with enterprise Independent Software Vendors (ISV).
- Experience selling enterprise software solutions through Cloud Marketplaces.
- Experience working with, and managing, complex sales scenarios with multiple parties with differing goals.
- Experience creating new sales motions to scale best practices.
- Ability to work with customer engineers and customers' technical decision makers to secure a joint opportunity.

About the Job

The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

As an ISV Sales Specialist, you will support the jointGo-To-Market (GTM) success of Independent Software Vendor (ISV) partners, including generating, advancing, and closing co-sell opportunities alongside the Google Cloud field sales team through the Google Cloud Marketplace.  You will work with ISV partners to create region-specific sales motions to increase awareness of the ISV within the Google Cloud field team, generate new leads, and accelerate active opportunities.  You will work with Google Cloud customers to support the evaluation, procurement, and usage of ISV partner solutions.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Germany: €114000 - €116000 (EUR) + 66.67% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

- 
Build and grow relationships with existing ISV partners and customers by closing joint opportunities with Google cloud sales account teams and Google’s ecosystem.

General information
Job ID 94299 Area Markets Products Start Date 01.07.2026 Contract Permanent Working Time Model Full-time Location(s) Berlin |

Corporate Treasury Sales partners with Germany’s leading corporates to navigate market risks with confidence - from  foreign exchange, interest rate and commodity solutions to securities and investment strategies. We combine sharp market expertise with the ability to design tailored OTC and investment products that truly move the needle for our clients. At CTS Germany, we bring this ambition to life through a high energy, team first culture: collaborative, curious, hands on and driven to deliver real impact. If you want to shape innovative Treasury solutions in a team that celebrates joint success, you will feel right at home with us.

What you can expect from us

- Advise corporate clients on investment and market risk solutions, securities, FX/MM and interest rate topics, with a clear commercial and closing-oriented focus.
- Drive the client risk management as well as investment business by identifying client needs, structuring tailored solutions, with main reponsibility for the full execution process.
- Develop and manage the client portfolio, taking responsibility for commercial results within your defined area.
- Closely monitor market developments to identify client opportunities and risk-related topics, driving initiatives forward with a strong execution mindset.
- Collaborate on business and sales strategies, bringing in your market insights and contributing to business unit-related strategy implementation.
- Unlock client potential and expand market share through proactive coverage, systematic follow-ups and high-quality advisory - while ensuring full regulatory compliance.
- Engage closely with internal partners to deliver comprehensive and tailored solutions for our clients.

What we expect from you

- Master’s degree in business administration, finance, economics, or a comparable field.
- Evidence of knowledge and experience according to § 87 Abs. 2 WpHG (2. FiMANoG) and §§ 1 & 6 WpHGMaAnzV.
- Proven sales expertise in investment and market risk solutions, securities, FX/MM and interest rate with the ability to advise clients and drive closings.
- Display a high level of commitment to proactive client outreach within the client portfolio to ensure best‑in‑class service and execution quality.
- Fluent German and English (spoken and written), with excellent communication and presentation skills.
- Very good understanding of business contexts.
- Show a keen interest in financial markets and up‑to‑date market movements.
- Thrive in a dynamic, fast‑moving environment.
- Good knowledge of accounting under HGB and IAS/IFRS.
- Familiarity with credit business, regulatory requirements (MiFID II, EMIR, Dodd Frank) and financial mathematics.
- Experience in foreign exchange and interest rate derivatives is a plus.
- High learning agility and an innovation and team-oriented mindset.

About Us

What if your work could drive change in a globally established industry, shaping processes that touch every corner of the world? At Forto, we are at the forefront of change, harnessing the power of AI to revolutionise logistics. We want to reinvent digital supply chains to be transparent, frictionless and sustainable. Your Role & Mission

The mission of the Flash team at Forto is to fundamentally redesign operations processes by leveraging automation and intelligent decision-making to handle shipments more efficiently. We aim to scale CoPilot so that it becomes the primary system used by operations managers, enabling them to be more effective and efficient in their daily work.

As a Senior Software Engineer in the Flash team, you will help build AI-driven solutions and the CoPilot that powers our logistics operations. You will maintain and evolve a sophisticated event-driven, distributed architecture designed to answer one key question:

How do we improve shipment handling and bring efficiency to our operations teams at scale?

From quotation and rate management, to shipment execution and schedule optimization (capacity utilization and GP optimization), to carrier integrations and automated data extraction from unstructured sources (emails, PDFs, spreadsheets), this role focuses on building reliable, data-heavy systems that directly impact revenue and operational performance.

- Contribute to an event-driven, distributed architecture

- Proven professional software craftsmanship, with a focus on building high-quality, maintainable, and testable code (an understanding of TDD is a plus).
- Expertise in designing and implementing large-scale, event-driven microservices architectures and robust APIs, with a keen understanding of data consistency in distributed systems.
- Deep understanding of synchronous vs. asynchronous communication patterns and their impact on system performance and reliability
- Hands-on experience developing distributed backend applications, with a strong focus on data consistency, system quality, low latency, and high availability.
- Proficiency in microservices, with hands-on experience in backend technologies such as Node.js, TypeScript, and MongoDB.
- Familiarity with Kubernetes and container orchestration for deploying and managing scalable pricing services.
- Experience with cloud providers (AWS or GCP preferred) for deploying and managing highly available and scalable applications.
- A collaborative, team-oriented mindset with strong critical product thinking and a sense of ownership over the accuracy and effectiveness of pricing data.
- Fluent in English, both verbal and written, for effective communication within a global team.

Preferred Skills and Experience

- Experience integrating AI/LLM-powered features into user faced applications
- Experience applying Domain-Driven Design (DDD) in complex product domains

In this Senior Principal Scientist (all genders) position within global CMC teams, you define and drive the DS strategy and are accountable for the DS contribution to the overall CMC package. - Guide and challenge route design and synthetic methodology choices at external CDMOs, translating SAR-driven chemistry into scalable routes for preclinical and clinical supply and future production in alignment with the internal DS development strategy
- Oversee external API campaigns for toxicology studies and clinical trials, including planning, risk assessment, supply-demand alignment, and budget oversight

- Contribute to robust, phase-appropriate control strategies. Co-author and review the Drug Substance sections of regulatory filings (IND/IMPD and briefing documents) and support responses to health authority questions
- Provide CMC DS assessments for in-licensing opportunities
- Provide chemical expertise and pragmatic troubleshooting across the internal and external manufacturing network. Actively contribute to the chemistry community by sharing knowledge and driving innovation across organizational boundaries

- Experience in the CMC development of peptides is a plus
- Experience in steering external partners (CROs/CDMOs) or working across an external manufacturing network is a clear advantage
- Proven ability to represent chemistry and Drug Substance in interdisciplinary CMC or project teams and to act as an accountable interface between the internal organization and external partners

Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. is the world leader in serving science, with annual revenue of approximately $40 billion. Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Whether our customers are accelerating life sciences research, solving complex analytical challenges, growing efficiency in their laboratories, improving patient health through diagnostics or the development and manufacture of life-changing therapies, we are here to support them. Our distributed team of over 100,000 colleagues provides an outstanding mix of brand new technologies, purchasing convenience, and pharmaceutical services across our top-tier brands like Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific, Unity Lab Services, Patheon, and PPD.

Location/Division Specific Information:

Phadia is the leading supplier of fully automatic blood analysis systems for allergy and auto-immune diseases. With our innovative products, we set standards worldwide and assist clinicians in providing fast and reliable diagnoses, thus helping patients at an early stage. Phadia GmbH in Freiburg is the German subsidiary of the Immunodiagnostics division of Thermo Fisher Scientific, a global company that develops, manufactures and distributes in vitro diagnostics in the field of allergy and autoimmune diagnostics. Our customers expect a consistently reliable and high standard of quality from our products, which we ensure through innovative biochemical and medical technology solutions as well as highly qualified and motivated employees.

A Day in the Life:

- Provide scientific support for the quality control and quality assurance of in vitro diagnostic (IVD) products for autoimmune diseases
- Perform quality control testing of Enzyme immunoassays (EIAs), antigens, raw materials, and reagents as part of routine production and development projects using advanced analytical techniques
- Provide technical guidance and supervision to technical staff
- Participate in projects related to the development and implementation of new products and analytical instruments, including LIMS integration
- Support the transfer of products and test methods from development into routine operations, working closely with colleagues in R&D and Production
- Contribute to projects focused on product lifecycle management and process optimization, including manufacturing and testing procedures as well as production equipment
- Drive continuous improvement initiatives
- Investigate and resolve deviations and customer complaints, and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) and continuous improvement measures
- Work with cross-functional teams to resolve quality issues, support regulatory audits, and implement process improvements
- Prepare and review study reports and standard operating procedures (SOPs) in compliance with applicable ISO and GMP requirements

Keys to Success:

- Advanced degree plus some years of experience, or Bachelor's degree plus many years of experience in GMP/GLP regulated laboratory environment
- Preferred Fields of Study: Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biology, Microbiology or related scientific field
- Extensive knowledge in development, production or quality control of Enzyme immunoassays (EIAs)
- Strong understanding of regulatory requirements (FDA, EMA, ISO, ICH guidelines)
- Experience with method validation, method transfer, and verification activities
- Proficiency in data analysis, trending, and statistical evaluation
- Demonstrated expertise in laboratory documentation and GMP compliance
- Strong technical writing skills for SOPs, protocols, and investigation reports
- Experience with LIMS and quality management systems
- Proven ability to lead investigations and implement corrective actions
- Excellent project management and organizational skills
- Strong interpersonal skills and ability to mentor staff
- Ability to work independently and as part of cross-functional teams
- Good to excellent proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both German and English

What we offer:

- Employment with an innovative, future-oriented organisation
- Outstanding career and development prospects
- Company pension scheme and other fringe benefits
- Exciting company culture which stands for integrity, intensity, involvement and innovation
